projection.growthBasis: Annual figure used as a constant rate; not projected. IMF Working Paper 2025/270: USD 725 billion explicit subsidies (undercharging for supply costs) plus USD 6.7 trillion implicit subsidies (undercharging for environmental and air-pollution externalities), 2024 data, totalling ~6.4% of global GDP.

source: IMF Working Paper 2025/270 — Underpriced and Overused: Fossil Fuel Subsidies Data 2025 Update

sources.name: IRENA — Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2023

categories.methodology: Capital cost to install 1 GW of utility-scale solar PV. IRENA's 2023 global weighted-average was $758/kW, so ~$1B installs ~1.3 GW — enough to power ~300,000 European homes.

sources.name: Rainforest Trust — Cost per acre protected

categories.methodology: Total cost to place all of Earth's remaining tropical rainforest under durable legal protection (USD 25/ha × ~1.8B ha).

sources.name: IEA — A Vision for Clean Cooking Access for All

categories.methodology: Average additional annual investment needed to achieve universal access to clean cooking in low- and lower-middle-income countries by 2030 — approximately USD 8 billion per year (up from ~$2.5B today), per IEA 'A Vision for Clean Cooking Access for All'.

sources.name: WMO — State of the Climate in Africa

categories.methodology: Estimated annual adaptation finance required for sub-Saharan Africa — approximately USD 51 billion per year (2023 prices), per UNEP Adaptation Gap Report 2025 (SSA requires $51B/yr; wider UNEP range $30–50B/yr over 2021–2030, ~2–3% of SSA GDP).

sources.name: IEA — Net Zero by 2050: A Roadmap for the Global Energy Sector

categories.methodology: Approximate annual investment in deep retrofits and energy efficiency for the global buildings sector required to reach net-zero — approximately USD 650 billion per year (IEA NZE: buildings efficiency investment must roughly double from ~$250B in 2022 toward ~$640B+ by 2050 for deep retrofit + efficient appliances).

Approximate capital cost of one full metro line or BRT corridor expansion in a major city — approximately USD 5 billion covers a metro extension (~30–40 km) plus a BRT network (~50–100 km) to expand mass transit. ITDP BRT Planning Guide: BRT $6–11.5M/km, metro/HRT ~$87M/km in lower-income settings.

sources.name: BloombergNEF — 1H 2024 Battery Price Survey (turnkey utility-scale BESS)

categories.methodology: Approximate all-in cost of 100 GWh of utility-scale lithium-ion battery storage — approximately USD 20 billion (100 GWh × ~$200/kWh all-in: BNEF 2024 turnkey ~$165/kWh global average, plus EPC/grid integration mark-up to ~$200/kWh).

sources.name: Laborde et al. — Ending hunger: science must stop neglecting smallholder farmers, Nature 2020

categories.methodology: Average additional annual public expenditure (~USD 33 billion) required to end hunger (SDG 2), per Ceres2030 / IFPRI.
